subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Analisar e avaliar os impactos das tecnologias na estruturação e nas dinâmicas de grupos, povos e sociedades contemporâneos (fluxos populacionais, financeiros, de mercadorias, de informações, de valores éticos e culturais etc.), bem como suas interferências nas decisões políticas, sociais, ambientais, econômicas e culturais.

components.description_pt: Analisar os impactos da tecnologia sobre a estrutura e dinâmica de sociedades contemporâneas
components.description_en: Analyze the impacts of technology on the structure and dynamics of contemporary societies
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Avaliar como fluxos digitais e tecnológicos (financeiros, informacionais, culturais) reconfiguram grupos sociais e povos
components.description_en: Evaluate how digital and technological flows (financial, informational, cultural) reshape social groups and peoples

components.description_pt: Avaliar a influência da tecnologia nos processos de tomada de decisão política, econômica, ambiental e cultural
components.description_en: Assess technology's influence on political, economic, environmental, and cultural decision-making processes
components.cc_component_description: Identify economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks associated with energy production or resource extraction

components.description_pt: Identificar implicações éticas e culturais da mudança tecnológica para dinâmicas sociais contemporâneas
components.description_en: Identify ethical and cultural implications of technological change for contemporary social dynamics
components.cc_component_description: Explain the societal implications of technologies that alter inheritance of desired traits

cc_matches.description: Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.

All forms of energy production and other resource extraction have associated economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical costs and risks as well as benefits. New technologies and social regulations can change the balance of these factors.
Gather and synthesize information about technologies that have changed the way humans influence the inheritance of desired traits in organisms.
